BiblicalUsage: Piphiyyah is an edge, a tooth — the cutting edge of a sword or a threshing tool. The saints have the high praises of God in their mouth and a two-edged sword in their hand in Psalms 149:6, and God makes Israel a sharp threshing instrument with teeth in Isaiah 41:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives His people an edge — praise in the mouth and a sharp instrument in the hand.
